dedupe_keys.name: large scale multipurpose benchmark datasets for data driven deep learning on water distribution networks tello et al 2024

description: This 2024 arXiv preprint, presented at the WDSA CCWI conference in Ferrara, releases a collection of datasets for assessing data-driven deep learning methods on water distribution networks. The authors note that most studies share only configuration files, leaving each user to generate data by running heavy simulations, and instead provide ready simulated data for several small and medium public networks: Anytown, Modena, Balerma, C-Town, D-Town, L-Town and the Kentucky networks Ky1, Ky6, Ky8 and Ky13, totalling 1,394,400 hours of operation under normal conditions. Coverage is those benchmark networks, not a real place. Access is free as an open preprint; the abstract page does not give the data location, file format or licence. Caveats: only normal operating conditions are described, the data repository was not read, and the paper is a preprint. Simulation uses: training and testing surrogate hydraulic models, state estimation and digital twins for water networks. Related records: DiTEC-WDN (data-ditec-wdn-hydraulic-scenarios), the Kentucky water distribution database (data-uky-water-distribution-system-research-database) and BattLeDIM (data-battledim-leakage-detection-benchmark).
